verdict.rationale: Fenwick's startup/VC practice page states it represents 1,500+ VC-backed companies and 100+ over $1B valuation, and facilitates investor introductions, plus a startup resource center covering seed financing — indicating broad venture financing coverage from seed to late stage. However, there is no stated deal volume specific to financing rounds (the $650B figure is for M&A/tech transactions, not equity financings) nor representative priced-round transactions listed. Missing for 10: representative named venture financing deals, stated financing deal volume/dollar figures specific to equity rounds, and stage-by-stage breakdown (seed/Series A-D/late-stage) evidence.
